methods.contract: new(executable => tmux, socket_name|socket_path => string, timeout => seconds, max_output => bytes, config_file => path, env => hashref); no I/O
execute(argv => arrayref, stdin => bytes?, timeout => seconds?, cancel_fh => handle?); raw CommandResult including nonzero exits
cmd(@literal_arguments); checked CommandResult or typed error; no shell or implicit command list
new_session(name => string, command => arrayref?, shell_command => string?, width => integer?, height => integer?, cwd => bytes?); Session; command/shell_command exclusive
new_window(session => Session|session_id, name => string?, command => arrayref?, shell_command => string?, cwd => bytes?); Window
split_pane(pane => Pane|pane_id, horizontal => boolean?, command => arrayref?, cwd => bytes?); Pane
snapshot(); strict captured Snapshot; no partial success on operational failure
listings(kind); fresh raw contextual hash rows, explicit I/O; kind session/window/pane/client
query_panes(where => criteria|Filter?, pushdown => auto|never|require?, native_filter => string?); PaneSelection; native_filter exclusive
explain_panes(where => criteria|Filter, pushdown => policy?); QueryPlan; no I/O until execution; reports conditional capability needs
rename_session(session => Session|session_id, name => string); void
rename_window(window => Window|window_id, name => string); void
link_window(window => Window|window_id, session => Session|session_id, index => integer?); void
unlink_window(link => WindowLink|session_id:index); void; contextual link only
move_window(link => WindowLink|session_id:index, session => Session|session_id, index => integer?); void
select_window(link => WindowLink|session_id:index); void; contextual link only
select_pane(pane => Pane|pane_id); void; physical active-pane change
select_layout(window => Window|window_id, layout => string); void
resize_pane(pane => Pane|pane_id, width => positive_integer?, height => positive_integer?); void
set_title(pane => Pane|pane_id, title => string); void; tmux sanitization remains observable
send_keys(pane => Pane|pane_id, keys => arrayref); void; named keys interpreted by tmux
send_text(pane => Pane|pane_id, text => string|bytes, enter => boolean?); void; literal text then optional Enter
capture_pane(pane => Pane|pane_id, start => integer?, end => integer?); raw bytes including tmux final newline
kill_pane(pane => Pane|pane_id); void
kill_window(window => Window|window_id); void; destroys physical window and all its links
kill_session(session => Session|session_id); void
kill_server(); explicit borrowed-server destruction requested by caller; void, no destructor alias
clients(); captured ClientSelection via explicit snapshot acquisition
attach_argv(session => session_id); fresh literal tmux argv for caller-owned interactive terminal; no I/O
detach_client(client => Client|client_name); void; acceptance, not client-exit proof
set_option(name => string, value => string|integer, scope => session|window|pane|server, target => id?, global => boolean?); void
get_option(name => string, scope => scope, target => id?, global => boolean?, inherited => boolean?); bytes; missing option raises CommandError
unset_option(name => string, scope => scope, target => id?, global => boolean?); void
set_hook(name => hook_or_hook[index], command => explicit_tmux_command_string, target => session_id?, global => boolean?); void
show_hooks(target => session_id?, global => boolean?); raw tmux bytes preserving sparse indexes and native quoting
set_environment(name => env_name, value => bytes, session => session_id?); void; global when session omitted
get_environment(name => env_name, session => session_id?); bytes; unset/missing throws
unset_environment(name => env_name, session => session_id?); void
set_buffer(name => string, data => bytes); stdin-backed load-buffer; void
show_buffer(name => string); raw bytes
delete_buffer(name => string); void
batch(arrayref_of_argv); arrayref CommandResults in input order; attempt all independent requests, retain per-request failures

adaptations.entity_operations: Captured read-only entities; all I/O uses explicit Server facade methods with ID or generation-checked handle.
adaptations.querylist: Concrete blessed-array Selection with fixed returns and declarative where/callback grep.
adaptations.refresh: New Snapshot acquisition, no mutation of captured handles.
adaptations.window_context: WindowLink is required for session-relative selection/movement/unlink.
adaptations.interactive_attachment: Caller-owned attach_argv; bounded capture transport does not own a TTY.
adaptations.raw_hooks: Sparse indexes/native quoted values retained in raw output, not flattened.
adaptations.legacy_aliases: Python deprecated aliases are excluded; named native Perl surface plus explicit cmd is authoritative.
adaptations.ui_helpers: Popup/menu/prompt/key-binding/clock/chooser wrappers are excluded; explicit cmd remains available where tmux supports the caller context.
adaptations.other_operations: Buffer save/load file, pane respawn/swap/join/break/pipe, server lock/access, wait-for, run-shell/source-file remain explicit cmd operations without wrapper parity claims.
adaptations.errors: Acquisition never converts failure to empty results.
